**What to build:** 查看主或子代理时显示该目标真实模型事实与自身结构，但 Total 的主树消费范围保持不变。

**Delivers:** P11, P21, P22

**Status:** ready-for-agent

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Effort 取实际生效值而非配置意图，主/子故意不同且不可取显示 ?，只给值着色；context/当前模型事实来自公开 Viewed session。
- [ ] Total 当前模型 Cache/Input/Output/命中率/结构参考取 Viewed session 自身当前 provider/model，不混其他模型或含后代累计。
- [ ] Total Sum/Cost/Ref 仍为原主会话和全部后代全部模型，查看子不丢父/兄弟，费用按各自单位，不因当前模式伪造免费。
- [ ] 主/子/孙/兄弟异构数据通过 S2 和隔离查看操作验证，故意让整树总值与目标自身字段不同；目标切换和同目标事实更新触发重读，不捕获旧 ctx。
- [ ] 准备 P11 H1 实际目标 Effort 场景、冻结 artifact、切换步骤及自动事实对照；主子 brief/detail 往返与偏好完整责任由 17 承担。
- [ ] 通过批准的生产公共 seam 观察行为，预期来自合同/规格、独立字面值或手算，不以被测实现重算；永久网络 tests 使用 mock。
- [ ] 使用隔离安装/配置/工作/Session/数据根，不操作正式 OMP；承接异步失败并保留够用脱敏证据，完成本票自动检查及材料准备，不因计划人工验收暂停可执行工作。

tests/model-cost/viewed-session-widget.test.ts (new, S5 seam with a controlled facts adapter driving the production frontend attachModelCostWidget: 6 cases)
tests/harness-dock/viewed-session-total.test.ts (new, S5 seam on the frozen patched host artifact: 2 real RPC runs)

criteria.Effort actual effective value not config: harness-dock/viewed-session-total.test.ts case 1 asserts the widget's Effort equals the host's own reported thinkingLevel (a real level, not ?) and follows set_thinking_level with no new model request (capture.requests stays 1) and an unchanged Total line; case 2 asserts a model with no settable effort shows 'Effort: ?'. The controlled widget suite asserts the widget reads the outlet rather than the bound session: the bound session is official/model-beta while the outlet publishes the subagent go-provider/model-alpha with no effort, and the widget shows the subagent's own 40% hit rate plus 'Effort: ?' (borrowing the binding would yield a 0% monetary result). S2 asserts two targets report different efforts (high/low) and that an unreported context draws no bar. Colour ('只给值着色') is visual and belongs to ticket 20's P67 H1; the minimal frontend has no colour.
criteria.Total current-model Cache/Input/Output/h: viewed-session-total.test.ts cases 1-3: viewing the sibling yields only that sibling's own pair (5/5/0/5, Sum 15, 50% hit rate) with its other own model, its parent's two pairs and its grandchild's pair excluded; session-sub switching between its official/model-beta pair (Sum 150, hit 0, ratio 0:50:50) and its go-provider pair (Sum 60, no amount, no ratio) changes only the current fields; the ratio is the viewed model's own price (alpha 4:7:89, beta 0:50:50, Codex 11:33:11:45 — all different) and no accumulated amount is re-priced.
criteria.Total Sum/Cost/Ref stay the original mai: viewed-session-total.test.ts cases 4-6: viewing the grandchild still reads the whole four-session tree (tokens 1582/2145/60/3325, Sum 7,112, Cost 0.8 CNY, Ref 0.05 USD, all hand-added); five targets (across sessions and across one session's two models) read the same tree while their own Sums are 6000/150/7/15/130, deliberately different; a token-only and a hidden target keep the tree's costCny and referenceCostUsd. The controlled widget case shows Sum/Cost literally unchanged (Sum: 6,100 Cost: ¥0.05) across a main->sub target switch while only the current-model part changes (Cache: 67% ¥Cache/In/Out：4:7:89 -> Cache: 40%).
criteria.Heterogeneous main/sub/grandchild/siblin: S2 file (four-session tree, five targets) plus the controlled S5 suite: a target switch redraws the new target's fields; a same-target change (model/effort/context) is re-read to the new values; after session_switch the previous ctx's outlet subscription is stopped and its later publications redraw nothing; detach stops the live subscription and clears the widget; hasUI!==true draws nothing.
criteria.Prepare the P11 H1 actual-target-Effort: Section 5 of the evidence asset: frozen artifact (its record.json hashes, re-materialisation command), isolated interactive launch, the focus-a-subagent switching steps, the three places to compare, expected values tied to the automatic results, the existing probes for automatic comparison, and what the RPC runs cannot cover. This ticket renders no detail tree/brief/Round (ticket 17's).
criteria.Observe through approved production publ: S2 reads only runtime.presentation through the framework's public binding (portDouble); the controlled cases read the production frontend's setWidget frames from a controlled host context; the real cases read only the host's own RPC answers (get_state / get_available_thinking_levels / set_thinking_level / setWidget frames) and the local capture endpoint. Every expectation is a spec literal (? , 450K, the two currencies, the tree scope) or a hand-added figure (7,112 / 0.8 / 0.05 / 6,100 / 0.00502 / ratios). No permanent case touches a real network.
criteria.Isolated install/config/work/session/dat: Real runs use the recorded .cache/omp-baseline/18.5.0-viewed-session artifact via ensureViewedSessionHarness (hash-verified) with createRunRoot agent state/--session-dir/work/capture/user-home; the storage root lands inside the run root's user-home; models.yml and the baseline document are written only into the run's own agent state. No restart, config change or command was issued against the formal OMP environment.
